notes:
CRM notes — fragments / call takeaways. Customer: StrataCove (mid-market B2B SaaS). Primary contact: CTO Lena Ortiz; PM: Aaron Kim. Use-case: in-app conversational assistant for product analytics + doc search. Started on Redwood Hosted API to validate latency and quality; now moving to Dedicated POC to hit production SLOs and lower unit costs.

POC objective: validate Dedicated throughput & latency at 95th pctile, quantify token-cost delta vs hosted, confirm model quality parity on core eval set, test canary+rollback automation and region failover.

Canary plan (proposed):
- Canary window: 72 hours, ramp to 5% traffic from production routing.
- Metrics watched: p95 latency target <350ms (goal), error rate <0.2%, semantic-match on eval prompts within 3% of hosted baseline.
- Observability: tracing + token-level cost breakdown in Redwood Console; custom eval hooks to run nightly regression checks.

Fallback / routing plan:
- Primary: Dedicated pool in us-west (pinned model variant: redwood-verified-13b-quant).
- Model-variant fallback: if p95 latency >500ms OR error rate >1% for >5min -> route to quantized 13B variant or to hosted_api fallback with same prompt context.
- Region failover: automated route shift to eu-west Dedicated pool (if us-west health degraded) — requires VPC route and latency check.
- Rollback triggers: nightly eval score drop >5% vs baseline OR manual rollback from SE/AE/Customer if coherence/regression observed.
- Safety: circuit-breaker threshold + automated traffic drain to hosted while preserving session KV cache where possible.

Security / compliance: require SSO/SAML for console, KMS integration for key management, audit logs for >=1 year, data residency clause (customer EU tenant for EU customers). Legal review ongoing (blocker).

Customer quotes: "We need predictable latency without building ops ourselves" — CTO L. Ortiz. "If Dedicated can hit p95 <350ms and demonstrate cost savings, we'll convert to reserved 12mo." — Head of Product A. Kim.

Stubs/links: security deck + runbook requested. Jira ticket opened for network setup (INF-4332).
